subject: SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph
notes: kb/Work PB1093 LANDED via PB1759 (owner decision R52): AlphabetFigurative answers the native extremes U+FFFF / U+0000 for both the alphanumeric and the national sequence (both are the 65,536 UTF-16 code units in code-unit order). cite.py --check 12.3.7.4 "When specified as literals in the SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph, the figurative constants HIGH-VALUE and LOW-VALUE are associated with those characters having the highest and lowest positions" -> OK 10). Goldens: ALPHABET AL IS HIGH-VALUE "B" "A" puts U+FFFF at ordinal 1 (LOW-VALUE ORD 1) and X"FF" in the tail (ORD 257, above "A"); CLASS HVC IS HIGH-VALUE holds CHAR(65536) and not CHAR(256).
